name: Club Finance Agent
description: Reads the rumor through fee, wage, transfer value, and club balance-sheet pressure.
evidence_bullets: Selling-side rumors can be financially constructive if they reduce wages or monetize an aging player.
risk_caveats: Wage data is often incomplete, so fee/value logic may miss salary pressure.

name: Market Reaction Agent
description: Reads the rumor through stock context, model signal, liquidity, and match-result timing.
evidence_bullets: Model/blended label is negative in the current payload.
Loaded stock path latest change is 28.00%.
37 match markers are present on the club stock path.
risk_caveats: Football club stocks are thin and can react to non-transfer news.
Recent stock path already moved materially, so some rumor/match information may be priced in.
Match-result markers overlap the stock path and can confound transfer-rumor interpretation.

name: Journalist Credibility Agent
description: Reads the rumor through source mix, journalist history, and rumor-stage reliability.
evidence_bullets: Multiple sources support the event cluster.
risk_caveats: No reporter profile is attached to this signal.
Aggregated articles can repeat the same underlying report, so source count is not pure independence.

name: Fan/Sentiment Agent
description: Reads the rumor through fan narrative, player importance, age, and role.
evidence_bullets: Selling Casemiro could be read as losing talent if he is viewed as important.
risk_caveats: Fan sentiment is proxied from role/age/position only; no social feed is included yet.

name: Risk Officer Agent
description: Challenges the scenario, flags weak evidence, and reduces overconfident conclusions.
evidence_bullets: Credibility is below the stronger-evidence band.
Rumor stage is early or unclear.
risk_caveats: Scenario output is for research triage only, not a buy/sell instruction.
No agent isolates causality from match results, ownership news, earnings, or market liquidity.
